title: Verdant 46 — Orc Warband: War Camp Tileset with Palisade, Huts and 35 Objects, RPG Maker MZ, Tiled & Godot [16x16]
shortText: An orc war camp in 16x16: palisade, stockade, war huts, 35 objects. RPG Maker MZ A2/A3/A4, Tiled + Godot.
description:
An orc war camp, complete enough to build a level from, in the Verdant series' 16x16 pixel-art look: 509 tiles, 35 objects and a finished 40x26 sample map. Commercial use permitted in unlimited projects, no attribution required; you may not resell the tiles themselves as an asset pack.

What is in it

  • A palisade and a stockade: sharpened stakes under log ends, and iron-banded logs under a split-log fighting deck, each with every corner, edge and end.
  • War huts and a longhouse: tanned hides laid in courses over a hide-and-pole wall, and thatch over log walls, with a hide-flap doorway and a plank door.
  • The camp ground: trampled earth with churned mud, scrub and scorched earth drawn into it, 3 complete sets of 47 shapes, plus 11 fill surfaces in 4 variants each.
  • 33 objects: hide tents, war banners, a totem pole, spike barricades, a cook fire, weapon, meat and trophy racks, a cauldron, a war drum, a gong, a war horn, an iron cage, training dummies, an anvil, a brazier, a war cart, a bone throne, plunder, wolf pelts, a tusk arch for the gate and more. Each ships transparent and grounded on trampled earth, mud and scorched earth with a contact shadow.
  • A 40x26 sample map (the war camp in the screenshots, 52 objects placed) as PNG, as JSON naming every cell, and as a Tiled .tmx.

Ready for three engines

  • RPG Maker MZ: the ground transitions are an A2 page and the huts and walls are A3 and A4 pages, so MZ's own brush shapes every corner as you paint; the objects are on B and C pages. All 144 A2 shapes and 192 A3/A4 shapes were composed back out of the pages by the engine's own autotile code and matched the tiles exactly. We also installed the pages in a blank MZ project, saved a map painted with every wall and roof shape, and ran that project's own drawing code on it: 192 of 192 cells identical. The RPG Maker MZ editor itself was not opened.
  • Tiled: .tsx tilesets for every sheet; the sample map's .tmx renders to the sample map PNG with 0 of 1064960 pixels different.
  • Godot 4: one TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2 (509 tiles built, every multi-cell object footprint exact). Tiled and Godot get every shape as a separate tile; no terrain rules are set up for you.

Made from the series

The camp's ground is the Verdant series' own: the trampled earth of Verdant 35 — Festival Fair, the mud of Verdant 08 — Mire, the scrub of Verdant 20 — Prison and the scorched earth of Verdant 44 — Aftermath, byte for byte, so this camp sits beside any of them. For more buildings and walls on the same MZ A3/A4 machinery, see Verdant 45 — Walls & Roofs. This pack still stands alone: everything it needs is in the download.

The proofs

Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed. Grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven: every tile is a whole number of 16x16 cells, every pixel is inside the 78-colour palette, alpha is strictly on or off, and all 11 autotile sets carry every shape.

AI disclosure

Every tile is generated by our own procedural drawing engine, which is AI-written software. No image model, no scraped art and no training dataset were used, and nothing was traced.
